batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-a-2013-2014-set2.pdf (4 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: A-ইউনিট, গাণিতিক ও পদার্থ বিষয়ক অনুষদ (Faculty of Mathematical and Physical Sciences), জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪; বিষয়ঃ গণিত (subject: Mathematics) — boxed 'Set CODE: 1/3', সময়: ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. The paper is therefore named by its printed subject and pair code (mathematics-set1-3); the Drive listing label 'Set-2' is just the archive's sequence number. 60 questions, interleaved with no printed subject sections, subjects assigned per question by content: Bangla Q3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13, 15 (8); English Q1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 14 (7); Higher Mathematics the remaining 44 (including the two dynamics items Q47 and Q49 — the paper has no Physics section); ICT Q51 (1). The compilation prints a boxed key beside each question (উত্তরঃ + Bangla letter; 'Ans:' + Latin letter for the English questions). 59 of 60 questions keyed; Q33's key letter is washed out under the aggregator watermark and is recorded keyless. Ten printed keys (Q16, Q17, Q24, Q29, Q37, Q43, Q47, Q52, Q54, Q58) appear to be compiler key errors; all are preserved as printed and flagged on the questions. Transcription was made from own 300-dpi renders of the PDF. Correction pass (after delivery): an independent second transcription of this paper disagreed at Q49, so pages 2-4 were re-verified strip-by-strip against the SHA-256-verified renders (p-2 7bdfc3bd…, p-3 74ecfffc…, p-4 813608fb…): Q16-45 were confirmed as transcribed, Q49's key was corrected to গ, and Q46-60 were re-transcribed from the renders — the first pass's page-4 readings had been taken from display tiles showing another paper's content (see EXTRACTION_NOTES_A1314A.md, second addendum). Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint of the JU A Unit 2013-2014 Mathematics subject paper (Faculty of Mathematical and Physical Sciences; printed Set CODE: 1/3). Aggregator header 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com', footer 'Get All University Admission Update From www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark overlaps several key boxes — the affected keys (Q17, Q18) were recovered with zoomed red-channel crops, which suppress the orange watermark; Q49's letter (গ) was confirmed on colour and red-channel re-crops in the correction pass; and Q33's key could not be recovered and is recorded keyless. A handwritten circled '৩' below the printed set-code box on p.1 is a reader's mark, not print. Printed question numbers use Western digits with leading zeros on p.1 (01., 02., …) and Bangla numerals on pp.2-4; appearances record Western digits.
